text_block_list.text:
On that day, in a room lined with golden trophies,
a certain girl was consulting with a doctor.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Ardan.
Adding more practice on top of this is reckless.
If you push yourself too hard, your legs will..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even if it shatters to pieces, I do not mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I never had much time left to begin with.
So rather than curse my fate, I should accept itâ"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“B-But even if I'm just an ordinary Umamusume,
I'm not giving up on my dream!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —I want to defy it with my own legs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even if, in the end, I fail to gain a single glimmer of light that rivals the brilliant trophies on the shelf.
I want to be myself, not just a little sister.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I do not want to give up on... who I am right now.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She's here! The "Little Sister"!!
A lady of the Mejiro family has graced us with her presence!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san! Word is that you've set your sights
on the Classic Triple Crown... specifically the Derby.
Is that true!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. That is the plan.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Then the glory your older sister, Mejiro Ramonu, built—
you're not aiming for the Tiara route!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
What a waste! The fans were so looking forward
to seeing you perform on par with your
Oka Sho and Yushun Himba victories, Ramonu-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“...... Yes, it is precisely because
my sister's glorious radiance shines so brightly.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "As 'Mejiro Ardan', I intend to dedicate everything that is my 'present' to the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even if it only emits a faint light, that is enough.
Unlike my sister's, these unreliable legs
are *my* legs, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“Yet in that fleeting instant,
I wish to carve a moment where I was truly myself,
rather than ‘somebody's something.’”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —This is surely my rebellion against destiny.

"That day, deep in the snow-covered mountains,
a girl honed her forms while facing nature head-on."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: SEIYAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...*Pant*, *pant*.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
SHUT UP!! QUIET DOWN!!
You little brats!!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Waaaahhhhh!!
Daddy, Yaeno's bullying meee!!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. This is why weaklings are so annoying.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
—You are the weak one, Yaeno.
Letting yourself be swayed by your own violence.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who—

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ………………Waaaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
However, from now on, that violence of yours
shall be dealt with by me, the head of the Kongo Yaegaki style—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
――Your grandfather will take you on.
Now, come at me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I was constantly irritated.
I swung my fists trying to vent it, but nothing cleared the air. The surging energy coursing through my body felt like it was slowly burning me up from inside.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She was isolated from those around her,
and I think even her parents worried about her future. But—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Grandpa, you were the only one who tried to guide me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When I was about to stray from the path,
she dealt with me patiently and brought peace to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And when I said I wanted to thank you for everything so far,
you simply smiled and replied,
"Your growth is the greatest thanks of all."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That is why I shall head toward the battle that decides
the pinnacle of Umamusume: the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In that ultimate battle every Umamusume strives for—the Derby.
I shall strike down my rival, and—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
By showing you how much I've grown,
I shall repay my debt of gratitude to you...!

"—On this day, while I was working in the Trainer's Office,
an unusual Umamusume came by to visit."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
I have come to ask a favor of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, I would like to decline
running alongside Chiyono O whenever possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Until the Derby.
To my surprise, the offer—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, could we please refrain
from running side-by-side with Chiyono O-san
as much as possible?
It covered the exact same topics as what Yaeno Muteki brought by earlier.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see, so both of you...
But why...?
choice_data_list: Maybe they just don't want to lose to you.
I think they just don't want to lose to you.

text_block_list.text:
The two likely know that
Sakura Chiyono O has her sights set on the Derby.
"That's precisely why I won't show my hand to an opponent. Nor do I intend to play nice and train together. It's all for the day that is to come—"
choice_data_list: If we're going to win the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I absolutely don't want to lose either!
Because... the Derby is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To me, the Derby is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It is something "special" that an ordinary person like me encountered.
Because it's a dream handed down to me by her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-Of course, I understand that it is special to regular Umamusume as well. A stage one can only challenge once in a lifetime, a place where anyone who dreams of racing longs to triumph.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“Yet Maruzen-san entrusted me
with a race that special.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Normally, you can't just entrust someone with the Derby dream.
That race isn't something to be taken so lightly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san's speed was overwhelming.
If she had been able to run in the Derby,
I'm certain she would have won.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yet they had no choice but to give up.
I don't know why. But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If she tells me she's entrusting it to me,
then I want to answer her in the form of victory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Having admired Maruzen-san for so long,
I will prove myself by winning.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If Maruzen-san had been able to run too,
she definitely would have won.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...There's a light on in the gym.

During practice, Sakura Chiyono O glanced over toward the gym
and stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder if Yaeno-san and Ardan-san are still staying behind to train themselves."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I thought rivalry... I thought the Classics...
were supposed to be much more refreshing than this."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Once you enter the gate for a once-in-a-lifetime race,
there's no room for grudges, no matter who wins.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Just like the race footage I've watched since I was young,
even in defeat, one must honor and praise the winner's efforts.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If I lose,
I think I'll just end up shaking and crying."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't just applaud like everything's fine.
I can't give empty praises either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...That's how strong my feelings are.
Because deep down in my heart, I truly want to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Since I've been entrusted with something by that person,
I'm not going to lose either...!
Those words sounded more powerful than anything she had ever spoken before.
